'''Salitt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] beggar who lived on the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Personality and traits==
Salitt was both paranoid and deluded, and he falsely claimed to be a former [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
